jobs.full_offer_html:
Job Title

Senior Python Engineer (Barcelona-based / Relocation support to Barcelona)

Job Description

Senior Python Engineer, Billing & Accounts

Manychat builds AI-powered automations that help creators and brands engage with their audiences on Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp and TikTok. We are 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth.

As a Senior Python Engineer you will create the Python foundation for Manychat's Billing: payments, payment provider integrations, anti-fraud and local regulatory compliance, all tied to the pricing model every feature depends on. There is no roadmap yet, so you will design systems end to end, make the architectural decisions and experiment with what works best. Two mid-level engineers will join after you, and you will help them grow.

What you will do

  • Design and build Billing's Python foundation, where product features and the existing PHP backend work together.
  • Build async Python services for payments, payment provider integrations, invoicing, anti-fraud and regulatory compliance.
  • Design and integrate internal and third-party APIs with clear, stable contracts.
  • Build for failure: retries, idempotency, consistency and observability, so every payment is handled correctly.
  • Set the testing, CI/CD and rollout practices this layer runs on.
  • Mentor and set the technical bar for two mid-level engineers.
  • Work with cross-functional partners so your technical decisions fit how the business runs.

What we offer

  • Hybrid onboarding (start remotely) and relocation support for you and your family
  • Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family
  • Professional development budget for conferences, courses and learning resources
  • Flexible benefits package tailored to your priorities
  • Hybrid work and generous leave options
  • In-office perks, including free meals and snacks
  • Company-funded sports activities, annual offsites and team-building events

Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you need an accommodation during the interview process, please indicate this in your application.

Restrictions

  • No telecommuting
  • No Agencies Please

Requirements

You need

  • 6+ years of commercial Python development in production, with Python as your primary language and recent hands-on work
  • Strong expertise in modern Python frameworks (FastAPI preferred; Django or Flask are fine)
  • Solid experience designing and integrating APIs, including third-party services
  • Strong understanding of async programming and concurrency (AsyncIO, non-blocking I/O)
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and large datasets
  • Experience building and maintaining backend systems under production load
  • Strong testing practices (unit and integration tests; PyTest preferred), CI/CD pipelines and Docker
  • Strong engineering judgment: you design systems end to end and make architectural decisions on your own
  • Mentoring or leadership experience of any kind
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams, with clear communication

Nice to have

  • Experience with billing, invoicing or payment systems
  • Experience with PHP
  • A product mindset and scale-up experience
  • Experience with queues, NoSQL or analytical systems
  • Deep database experience, such as replication, partitioning, sharding or PL/pgSQL
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools in your engineering work

About the Company

Creating content that resonates is great, and turning that attention into growth is even better. That is what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with their audiences on Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp and TikTok: at the right moment, with the right message, and without the manual work.

We are 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work and how we grow. Manychat runs under serious load every day, and our stack is built for speed and durability.

Contact Info

  • Contact: Yuliya Lurye
  • E-mail contact: yuliya.lurye@manychat.com
  • Web: https://careers.manychat.com/

jobs.full_offer_text: Here at Ailytics, we're building AI solutions to envision a safer world. By combining computer vision and predictive analytics, we enable organizations to proactively identify risks, optimize processes, and ultimately save lives. Our platforms are currently deployed all over the world, covering more than 500 million square meters! As a Django Backend Engineer, you will build and maintain the systems that sit between our AI and our customers: the APIs, data models and services that turn a continuous stream of detections into the dashboards and mobile apps our customers rely on every day. You will work in a small, senior team with a direct line to our CTO, Product Managers and senior management, which means little distance between deciding something and shipping it. We are looking for someone who is comfortable leading projects, not just completing tickets: taking a problem, scoping it, building it, and owning it through to production. This is a fully remote role. We are open to candidates within 2.5 hours of Singapore's time zone. What You Will Be Doing Design, build, optimize and maintain production applications using Django and Django REST Framework. Develop REST APIs, complex relational data models and scalable backend services. Optimize Django ORM queries, PostgreSQL performance, indexing and database operations. Build and maintain asynchronous processing workflows using Celery, Redis and message brokers. Independently own backend features from requirements gathering and technical design through development, testing and production deployment. Troubleshoot production issues and improve system reliability, performance and maintainability. Apply strong data structures and algorithms fundamentals when solving performance and scalability challenges. Collaborate closely with Product, AI and Engineering teams. Actively use AI-assisted development tools throughout planning, implementation, debugging, code review, testing and documentation. Our Ideal Requirements At least 3 years of professional, hands-on production Django experience, preferably 4+ years. Strong practical experience with Django REST Framework, Django ORM, models, migrations, authentication and permissions. Django must be a primary backend framework in your current or most recent professional role. Proven experience designing, maintaining and optimizing complex production Django applications. Strong PostgreSQL skills, including database design and query optimization. Experience with Celery, Redis, asynchronous tasks and message queues such as RabbitMQ or Kafka. Strong backend problem-solving skills and the ability to independently troubleshoot production issues. Hands-on experience using AI development assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar tools across multiple stages of the development lifecycle. Comfortable working as a hands-on individual contributor in a fast-moving startup. Strong English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote environment. Good To Have (Not Required) Experience working with AWS or other major cloud providers. Docker, CI/CD pipelines and automated testing. Experience with high-volume event processing or distributed systems. Familiarity with FastAPI, Flask, TypeScript or frontend development. Why Work At Ailytics? Lasting impact at the intersection of AI and safety. Our systems are used daily by enterprise customers across Asia and beyond, in environments where a missed detection genuinely matters. We're a startup still in its early stages, so there's real room to shape both the product and the way we build it. You will work in a small, senior team with real ownership. You lead projects, make architectural calls, and see them in production quickly. We value strong standards, high transparency, and low egos. Let us know if this sounds like you. Job Category: Full-Time Job Type: Fully Remote- Eligible Southeast Asian Countries Working Hours: Singapore-aligned
jobs.full_offer_html:
Here at Ailytics, we're building AI solutions to envision a safer world. By combining computer vision and predictive analytics, we enable organizations to proactively identify risks, optimize processes, and ultimately save lives. Our platforms are currently deployed all over the world, covering more than 500 million square meters!

As a Django Backend Engineer, you will build and maintain the systems that sit between our AI and our customers: the APIs, data models and services that turn a continuous stream of detections into the dashboards and mobile apps our customers rely on every day. You will work in a small, senior team with a direct line to our CTO, Product Managers and senior management, which means little distance between deciding something and shipping it.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable leading projects, not just completing tickets: taking a problem, scoping it, building it, and owning it through to production.

This is a fully remote role. We are open to candidates within 2.5 hours of Singapore's time zone.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Design, build, optimize and maintain production applications using Django and Django REST Framework.
  • Develop REST APIs, complex relational data models and scalable backend services.
  • Optimize Django ORM queries, PostgreSQL performance, indexing and database operations.
  • Build and maintain asynchronous processing workflows using Celery, Redis and message brokers.
  • Independently own backend features from requirements gathering and technical design through development, testing and production deployment.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and improve system reliability, performance and maintainability.
  • Apply strong data structures and algorithms fundamentals when solving performance and scalability challenges.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, AI and Engineering teams.
  • Actively use AI-assisted development tools throughout planning, implementation, debugging, code review, testing and documentation.

Our Ideal Requirements

  • At least 3 years of professional, hands-on production Django experience, preferably 4+ years.
  • Strong practical experience with Django REST Framework, Django ORM, models, migrations, authentication and permissions.
  • Django must be a primary backend framework in your current or most recent professional role.
  • Proven experience designing, maintaining and optimizing complex production Django applications.
  • Strong PostgreSQL skills, including database design and query optimization.
  • Experience with Celery, Redis, asynchronous tasks and message queues such as RabbitMQ or Kafka.
  • Strong backend problem-solving skills and the ability to independently troubleshoot production issues.
  • Hands-on experience using AI development assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar tools across multiple stages of the development lifecycle.
  • Comfortable working as a hands-on individual contributor in a fast-moving startup.
  • Strong English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote environment.

Good To Have (Not Required)

  • Experience working with AWS or other major cloud providers.
  • Docker, CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
  • Experience with high-volume event processing or distributed systems.
  • Familiarity with FastAPI, Flask, TypeScript or frontend development.

Why Work At Ailytics?

  • Lasting impact at the intersection of AI and safety. Our systems are used daily by enterprise customers across Asia and beyond, in environments where a missed detection genuinely matters.
  • We're a startup still in its early stages, so there's real room to shape both the product and the way we build it.
  • You will work in a small, senior team with real ownership. You lead projects, make architectural calls, and see them in production quickly.
  • We value strong standards, high transparency, and low egos. Let us know if this sounds like you.

Job Category: Full-Time Job Type: Fully Remote- Eligible Southeast Asian Countries Working Hours: Singapore-aligned
